subject: Task 6 done: 13 blocking findings applied, 4 minor rejected
body: Verified all 17 review findings against the cited sources and applied the 13 blocking ones (R1-R13) to specs/orca-worker-contract-spec.md (57763 -> 66484 bytes, 12 hunks), each placed inside its anchor line so the ledger can claim it; the 4 minor ones (R14-R17) are confirmed true but rejected as deferred and not answerable under the reviser contract. Left for the coordinator: run the ledger step (answer --input review/disposition.md, dry-run passed with 13 claims and 7 gap notes, then begin --doc <spec> --revert-unclaimed) and review 2 of 3; the spec has no placeholder left.
